analysis: The trial failed before training: the host reported invalid_source with a syntax error at line 210 and 0.0 allocated GPU seconds. The source contains unresolved `=======` merge markers and duplicated forward implementations. It also contains stray statements and obsolete references to an undefined `_attention_mask`, so removing only the reported syntax error would not fully repair it. No validation score was produced; the proposed R-Drop change has no measured outcome. The 0.5800 reference is prior context, not this trial’s result.
code_summary: Intended architecture: one independently trained bidirectional MaskedSASRec per category, with 96-dimensional item/position embeddings, two Transformer blocks, two attention heads, dropout 0.2, an output projection, and jointly learned item bias; no relative attention bias. Training uses final and auxiliary masked-item reconstruction with 256 shared sampled negatives. Two dropout passes through the same network average cross-entropy losses and add 0.1 times symmetric KL, retaining equal final/auxiliary weighting. AdamW trains each category separately; validation selects one checkpoint per category. The predictor writer is intended to strictly load that checkpoint and use one deterministic forward pass. Repair requires restoring the single original bias-free forward implementation and removing all merge debris and stale relative-bias code.
